title: 60+ House Democrats Urge Netanyahu to Stop Settler Violence After IDF Troops Injured
detail: Over 60 US House Democrats sent a letter to Prime Minister Netanyahu urging concrete action to stop settler violence in the West Bank following a wave of attacks that injured IDF troops. The letter signals growing congressional pressure on Israel over unchecked settler activity in the occupied West Bank.

title: US Senate Blocks Resolution Requiring Report on Americans Killed in West Bank
detail: The US Senate blocked a resolution that would have required the State Department to report on Americans killed or injured in the West Bank. Republican senators opposed the measure, preventing increased congressional oversight of violence against US citizens in occupied territory.

media.caption: US Senate blocks resolution on Americans killed in the West Bank

title: UN Adds 61 Companies to Database of Businesses Linked to Illegal Israeli Settlements
detail: A new report identified 61 companies newly linked to illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank, adding them to the UN database of businesses with operations in occupied territory. The database expansion reflects continued international scrutiny of corporate ties to Israeli settlements deemed illegal under international law.
